source_text: Penile cancer, a rare malignancy with an incidence of less than 1 per 100,000 in developed countries, shows a strong protective association with childhood or adolescent circumcision (odds ratio 0.33), linked to decreased chronic inflammation and human papillomavirus persistence under the foreskin.
